title: Honda OBD/OBD2 Codes >> Honda 84-85 Accord & 87 Civic

procedures.heading: General Information
steps: Trouble codes are displayed by four LED’s in engine control module (ECM) 1
LED’s are numbered 8-4-2-1, left to right

procedures.heading: Accessing Trouble Codes
steps: Access engine control module (ECM):
Civic 2
Accord 3
Switch ignition ON
Check MIL illuminates
Check LED’s in ECM are flashing
Count LED flashes and compare with trouble code table below
If malfunction indicator lamp (MIL) is ON constantly and no trouble codes are displayed (LED not flashing), this indicates an engine control module (ECM) fault
Switch ignition OFF

procedures.heading: Clearing Trouble Codes
steps: After the faults have been rectified, erase the trouble codes as follows:
Civic – Remove fuse No. 10 (10A) from LH fascia fusebox for 10 seconds minimum
Accord – Disconnect battery ground cable for 10 seconds minimum
Reinstall fuse
Repeat accessing procedure to ensure no data remains in ECM fault memory

Remove jump lead

title: Honda OBD/OBD2 Codes >> Accord 2.3/2.4/3.0L – Civic 1.7/2.0L – CR-V 2.4L – Odyssey 3.5L – S2000 2.2/2.2L (1998 – 2008)

procedures.heading: General information
steps: Refer to the front of this manual for general test conditions, terminology, detailed descriptions of wiring faults and a general trouble shooter for electrical and mechanical faults.
Engine control module (ECM) incorporates self-diagnosis function.
Malfunction indicator lamp (MIL) will illuminate if certain faults are recorded.
ECM operates in backup mode if sensors fail, to enable vehicle to be driven to workshop.

Trouble codes can be displayed by using a Scan Tool connected to the data link connector (DLC) Accord [1] , CR-V/Odyssey [2] , S2000 2000-04 [3] Civic/S2000 2005- [4] or by the malfunction indicator lamp (MIL) with the data link connector (DLC) terminals jumped [5].

procedures.heading: Accessing
steps: Ensure ignition switched OFF.
Jump data link connector (DLC) terminals 4 and 9 [5].
Switch ignition ON.
Check MIL is flashing.
Trouble codes 1-9 are indicated as follows:
Trouble codes greater than 9 are indicated as follows:
Count MIL flashes and compare with trouble code table.
Switch ignition OFF.
Remove jump lead.

procedures.heading: Erasing – except Accord 2003 ->
steps: After the faults have been rectified, trouble codes can be erased by using a Scan Tool connected to the data link connector (DLC) or as follows:
Switch ignition OFF.
Accord: Remove clock fuse (7.5A) from fascia fusebox for 10 seconds minimum [8]
Civic/CR-V: Remove ECM fuse (15A) from underhood fusebox for 10 seconds minimum [9]
Odyssey: Remove Clock/Back Up fuse (7.5A) from fascia fusebox for 10 seconds minimum: 1999 – [1o] or 2000-04 – [11]
S2000: Remove Back Up fuse (7.5A) from fascia fusebox for 60 seconds minimum [12] .
Reinstall fuse.
Repeat checking procedure to ensure no data remains in ECM fault memory.

procedures.heading: Erasing – Accord 2003 ->
steps: Trouble codes can only be erased by using a Scan Tool connected to the data link connector (DLC) [1].
